training_cutoff_rule: For each target t, construct the model using rounds 1..t-1 only. The target draw and every later draw are excluded from all training, candidate selection, model calculation, and tie-breaking.
hypothesis: The legacy S008 structure family is rank-constant because its 45 constant vectors contribute the same 270/51 value to every number. Replacing that expansion with one frozen 45-dimensional number-membership vector from the S005 structure-transition ticket will produce a distinct, cutoff-safe H005_FIX single-ticket ranking; its overall mean hits will be compared with the exact six-of-45 hypergeometric baseline.
legacy_mapping_proof: Legacy S008 appends 45 constant vectors (six [45]*45 and thirty-nine [0]*45) to six component-rank vectors, for 51 vectors total; the structure contribution is 270/51=5.2941176470588235 for every number and is therefore rank-constant.
corrected_mapping: One 45-dimensional family vector: 45 for each of the six numbers in the S005 structure ticket, 0 for the other 39; append this vector once to the six S001/S002/S003/S004/S006/S007 rank vectors and average seven families.
primary_metric: Overall mean main-number hits per H005_FIX single-ticket prediction minus the exact hypergeometric six-of-45 expected mean across targets 201..1250.
secondary_metrics: ticket overlap and hit/score correlations versus legacy S008 and S005 references
comparator: Frozen legacy S008 reconstruction using six unchanged component-rank vectors plus 45 constant structure vectors; S005 structure-transition ticket is a reference-only comparator.
multiplicity_and_selection: One corrected mapping, one model, one fixed candidate bank. No parameter search, no model selection, and no variants. Fixed windows are descriptive, not independent confirmatory tests; no inferential promotion is permitted from this historical screen.
historical_classification_rule: WEAK if the overall, recent100, or recent50 mean-hit delta versus exact random is <=0; otherwise HOLD. This descriptive rule is not a significance test and cannot create purchase readiness.
promotion_rule: HISTORICAL_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY. No promotion, no prospective confirmation, no three-line portfolio evaluation, no STRICT_PASS_READY, and no purchase numbers. Any future promotion requires a separately preregistered untouched prospective design and the unchanged target-specific three-line strict portfolio gates.
